mapper.sql: e.id, to_char(e.entry_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "entryDate", e.type, e.category_id AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", e.title, e.amount, e.payment_method_id AS "paymentMethodId", p.name AS "paymentMethodName", e.memo
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN payment_method p ON p.id = e.payment_method_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_entry (user_id, entry_date, type, category_id, title, amount, payment_method_id, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{entryDate}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethodId}, #{memo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ledger_entry WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
